title.narrative: Enabling Digital Transformation and Improving Public Service Delivery at scale in Guatemala

description.narrative: This Joint Programme (UNDP -LEADER AGENCY- UNICEF, UNESCO) seeks to accelerate the digital transformation of public services in Guatemala by addressing existing gaps that are hindering the effectiveness of digital initiatives to drive transformative change at scale (position 126 out of 183 according to UNDESA E-Government Survey and 0.5118 score in the Online Service Index). Under the leadership of the Presidential Commission for Open and Electronic Government, this JP will (1) strengthen digital governance frameworks through the development and or update of policy and regulation advocacy mechanisms for data protection, privacy, management, and sharing (2) accelerate the digital transformation of public services through the collaborative update and design of a comprehensive national digital strategy and supporting the design and initial deployment of open architectures for data exchange and digital identity digital public infrastructures, with a focus on social protection, education, and climate resilience, and (3) enable the fulfillment of digital human rights and digital inclusion of vulnerable populations, prioritizing women, adolescents, youth, and indigenous peoples by strengthening their digital skills and promoting citizen engagement mechanisms to ensure inclusive digitalization of public services.
